what_happened: Scene layout 7 / style 7: single dark basin, swivel gooseneck faucet, wire-mesh colander (Colander012) with a long wire handle LEFT of the sink. Stage 0: water on at 231 (median 253). Lever pushed 204-225 (0.25 at 224, 0.50 at 240). The gripper took the colander's wire handle at ~392 (fingers only close to ~0.07 on the thin wire, so no close_event), swung it right and held it under the stream ~520-556 with the spout still pointing forward. Stage 1 took 325 steps (median 303); success at 556. No errors.
official_criterion_notes: No close_event although the colander was grasped: the fingers only closed to ~0.06-0.07 around the colander handle/rim, below the 0.02-drop trigger.
